Progress on Transition Metal-Doped ZnO Nanoparticles and Its Application
top_cited_works.abstract: ZnO nanoparticles are still a hot area for research even after ample work has been done by researchers across the world. It is a versatile material for doping of different transition metals among other metal oxides. Having a large family of morphological structures, high electron mobility, and n-type carrier defects, it is suitable for a number of applications such as memory devices, spintronics, optoelectronic devices, solar cells, and sensors. Here, we have emphasized a review of the effects of transition metal (TM) doping on the different physical properties of ZnO nanoparticles and their applications. We have gone through some theoretical models which were used by most of the researchers for explaining the variations in physical properties. Explanation of the sensing, photocatalytic, and optoelectronic processes in different classes of devices is briefly described. Lastly, the comparative studies of different devices are also made available for clear understanding.

recent_works.title: Information Security and Clinical Ethics in LLM-Based Healthcare Systems
recent_works.venue: Advances in computational intelligence and robotics book series
recent_works.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) play a complex and ever-evolving role in medicine. LLMs, in general, can help medical professionals identify patients by giving them fast, data-driven information. They are able to analyse patient data, compare it with a comprehensive medical history, and make recommendations for potential diagnoses or identify issues that need more research. This chapter examines the threats that prompt injection attacks, perfect overturn, and data leak could pose to PHI and offers solutions to lessen these risks through federated learning, secure model design, and privacy-preserving AI methods. These models are very decent at comprehending and producing human language and are built on deep learning and natural language processing technologies. LLMs have developed exceptional skills in vocabulary, grammar, semantics, and specialized knowledge, particularly in medicine, thanks to the extensive training on vast amounts of textual material. A proposal for an ethical framework to safeguard that medical LLMs operate within the bounds of patient trust closes the chapter.

recent_works.title: Solar Energy Policies and Regulations
recent_works.abstract: The global shift toward sustainable and renewable energy has positioned solar power as a central pillar of modern energy policy and regulation. Over the past two decades, advancements in solar technologies, combined with increasing environmental concerns, have prompted governments and international organizations to develop supportive policies and regulatory frameworks. These include financial incentives, feed-in tariffs, net metering schemes, renewable energy targets, and subsidy mechanisms, all aimed at accelerating deployment, attracting investment, and facilitating smooth grid integration. At the same time, international standardization bodies such as the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) and national organizations like the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), Underwriters Laboratories (UL, USA), and the European Norms (EN) have introduced rigorous technical standards to ensure quality, safety, and performance in solar photovoltaic and solar thermal systems. recent_works.title: A Novel Explainable Techniques Tailored for Consumer Electronics in Real-Time Health Monitoring
recent_works.abstract: The increasing need for immediate health tracking in consumer electronics requires the creation of transparent and trustworthy methods for identifying diseases. This paper presents a new Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) framework tailored for identifying chest illnesses through computationally efficient and near–real-time deployment health monitoring systems. Our framework combines state-of-the-art deep learning approaches with interpretable AI methods to facilitate clear decision-making processes and maintaining high precision in classifying chest diseases. The suggested method uses data preprocessing, attention techniques, and model interpretability strategies for consumers and healthcare experts to grasp the rationale behind the system’s predictions more effectively. Thorough testing performed on a large dataset of chest radiograph images (CXR) showcases the remarkable effectiveness of the framework that attains an average accuracy exceeding 97% in identifying different chest abnormalities. recent_works.abstract: Background: The timing of dental implant placement, whether immediate or delayed following tooth extraction, significantly impacts clinical outcomes, esthetic results, and patient satisfaction. A comprehensive understanding of both protocols is essential for optimizing treatment planning and success rates. Objectives: This review aims to compare immediate and delayed implant placement in terms of clinical outcomes, survival rates, and patient satisfaction. Additionally, it discusses indications, contraindications, and critical factors influencing the choice between these approaches. Methods: Relevant studies, systematic reviews, and clinical trials from peer-reviewed journals were analyzed to assess the outcomes associated with both immediate and delayed implant placements. Key parameters evaluated included implant survival, esthetic results, patient-reported satisfaction, and complications.
